Depends on #43804; only commits after it are new.

## Motivation

With 4 EAGLE3 draft tokens, MiniMax-M3's sparse layers score each verify token as its own decode row (#41497, #43804), reading a request's index K 4 times. At AgentX c16 on GB300, `_decode_score_kernel` is 15.0 ms of a 36.1 ms verify step (nsys, one rank).

## Modifications

- New `_decode_score_packed_kernel`: a request's `packed_queries` rows share one 16-row dot tile, so each K tile loads once; each row keeps its own length mask, and both kernels run the same 16-row MMA, so max scores equal the per-row kernel's.
- `flash_decode_with_topk_idx` packs on CUDA for score-only layers, whole groups and `packed_queries × gqa ≤ 16`; `minimax_sparse_decode` forwards `packed_queries` (from #42614). SM90 keeps its paged (#46135) and per-row kernels, ROCm the per-row kernel.
- The packed kernel runs one fixed config (BLOCK_SIZE_N 128, 4 warps, 2 stages; within 13 % of a sweep's best): autotune would tune on the 1-token CUDA-graph warm-up rows and differ per rank.
- A second kernel rather than a `PACK` option on `_decode_score_kernel`, so the per-row kernel keeps its CUDA autotune and ROCm heuristics; its chunk-count rule moves unchanged into `_num_kv_chunks`, which #46135's paged launch also calls with its cap of 1024.

Prior art: AMD draft #39466 (needs local_blocks > 0), merged #45251 (DeepSeek-V4.1 indexer).

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K (sgl-eval 0.1.3 cookbook + `--max-tokens 32768`), MiniMax-M3-NVFP4, 4× GB300 TP4, EAGLE3 at real acceptance, `SGLANG_DISABLE_MSA=1`:

| GSM8K | #43804 | + this PR |
|---|---|---|
| 1,319 q | 96.74 % | 97.12 % |
| 100 q, one at a time | 98 % | 98 % |

- New `test_minimax_sparse_decode_packed_score.py` (22 passed, GB300; B200 CI, skipped on SM90): packed = per-row scores and selected-block scores (max; lse via the Triton top-k), incl. local_blocks 0, fp8 K and graph replay.
- `test_minimax_linear_verify.py` now asserts one packed launch per score-only verify forward (none on SM90) and also runs on B200; it and the decode top-k (160), page-table top-k (38) and sparse kernel (54) tests pass on GB300 after merging main.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Index step (score + top-k), one layer, one TP4 rank, GB300, cold-L2 `marker.do_bench`; per-row → packed µs, same top-k:

| index K / q | 16 req × 131K | 32 req × 524K |
|---|---|---|
| bf16 / bf16 | 293.1 → 119.1 (2.46×) | 2,089.8 → 825.5 (2.53×) |
| fp8 / fp8 | 238.3 → 87.4 (2.73×) | 1,779.6 → 595.1 (2.99×) |

AgentX replay on 4× GB300, EAGLE3 at synthetic AL 2.78, same node; PR arm: earlier revision, same kernel math:

| c16 | tok/s/user (1000/p90 ITL) | total tok/s/GPU | p90 TTFT |
|---|---|---|---|
| #43804 | 31.9 | 12,931 | 6.85 s |
| + this PR | 79.2 | 14,733 | 3.89 s |

<details><summary>Reproduce</summary>

Server (both arms; `#43804` or `#43804` + this PR on `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20261012-e6072935`, 4× GB300):

```
SGLANG_DISABLE_MSA=1 python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path nvidia/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 --trust-remote-code --tp 4 --context-length 1048576 --reasoning-parser minimax-m3 --tool-call-parser minimax-m3 --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"thinking_mode":"enabled"}' --enable-metrics --enable-cache-report --random-seed 42 --speculative-algorithm EAGLE3 --speculative-draft-model-path Inferact/MiniMax-M3-EAGLE3-GQA --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 --speculative-draft-model-quantization unquant
```

GSM8K (the 1,319 questions, then the first 100 one at a time):

```
sgl-eval run gsm8k --base-url http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1 --thinking --temperature 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --max-tokens 32768
sgl-eval run gsm8k --base-url http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1 --thinking --temperature 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --max-tokens 32768 --num-examples 100 --num-threads 1
```

AIPERF_EXPERIMENTAL_FAST=1 agentx profile --url http://127.0.0.1:30000 --model nvidia/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 --tokenizer nvidia/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 --tokenizer-trust-remote-code --concurrency 16 --benchmark-duration 1200 --warmup-requests-per-lane 1 --server-metrics http://127.0.0.1:30000/metrics --public-dataset semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126

[by Claude Code] **Severity: style | Confidence: High**

**Issue**

The Accuracy Tests and Speed Tests sections give the model, GPUs, TP, and results, but no commands. Others cannot rerun the GSM8K, index-step, or AgentX numbers.

**Fix**

Add the server launch command (EAGLE3 draft model and `--speculative-*` flags) and the full `sgl-eval` command for GSM8K, the script behind the index-step table, and the server and AgentX replay commands for both arms, including how acceptance was fixed at AL 2.78.

**Why it matters**

nsys puts the score kernel at 15.0 of 36.1 ms per verify step, so a 2.5x faster kernel saves about 9 ms. The AgentX table shows 2.5x tok/s/user, so the commands would help others check where the rest of the gain comes from.

[by Claude Code] **Severity: functional | Confidence: Medium**

**Issue**

The PR body says this test relies on #45174, which is still open. On this branch, the CUDA radix top-k in `minimax_decode_topk.cuh` still places final-round ties with `atomicAdd(&smem->counter_final, 1)`. Rows with more than 128 blocks use that path: the `long` and `clamped` cases and `test_graph_replay_at_longer_context`. When two blocks tie at the top-k boundary, the packed and per-row runs can pick different ids, so `torch.equal(got, want)` can fail from run to run.

**Fix**

Land #45174 first and say so in the PR body. Or make the check tie-invariant: `_assert_rows_equal` already proves the scores match, so for block ids compare the sorted `want_score` values at `got` and at `want`.

The PR body says this test relies on #45174, which is still open. On this branch, the CUDA radix top-k in `minimax_decode_topk.cuh` still places final-round ties with `atomicAdd(&smem->counter_final, 1)`.
